content_html:
watched #NTR-Kathanayakudu – DISSAPOINTED!!!

COULD HAVE BEEN A BETTER MULTI-SEASON WEBSERIES RATHER THAN A MOVIE!!!!

to begin with, I generally classify the audiance watching a Biopic into 3 categories…

1. People who want to relive the charisma of the person
2. People who want to know the ups and downs in the life of the person and how he/she overcame the challanges faced
3. People who care a shit of above 2 points and watch it as a normal movie

#Mahanati was a classic hit because it had content to cater all the 3 classifications….unfortunately Kathanayakudu fails in that aspect as there is no much failures of NTR after his initial struggle which is essential to create the much needed drame….though there are some 4 – 5 scenes which elevate the drama but the quantity is much less to sustain the drama for the whole 3 hrs long movie!!!!

rather than getting carried away with the awe factor of a Son essaying the role of his real father in movies…..probably Krish/Balaya could have applied some logic that its easy to show case a person in his youth as an middle aged or old man with make up…..but the vice versa is not possible!!!! Just couldnt digest the fact and somehow it was pain to watch Balaya who is in his late 50’s? as a youngster who wants to chase his dreams!!! Having said that Balaya has put in 1000% efforts to make this movie a memorable one for his family, party and hardcore fans of NTR….but some how the movie is missing the depth to cater to larger audiance

The whole Mayabazar Lord Krishna role scene was excellently shot……should have totally avoided Balaya babus self dabba scene!!!only later part of 2nd half was engaging. but the time you reach that point you will be vexed up with endless movie parodies 😦

Finally Watch it….for Balaya and to know a high level glimpse of the stories and incidents which we have already known!!!!

Hope atleast Mahanayakudu…..caters to all the 3 classifications of the audiance!!! till then I am ready to take the warth of all NTR Balaya and TDP fans 😛
